# `aitbc tee attest`

Attest a TEE enclave and verify its measurement.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc tee attest [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--enclave-id` | text | — | yes | The Enclave-id. |
| `--measurement` | text | — | no | Expected enclave measurement |
| `--key-file` | text | — | no | Path to a stable signing key (see 'aitbc tee keygen'). Without this, each call signs with a fresh random key, so there is nothing stable here for 'aitbc tee register' to pin against. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc tee attest --enclave-id <enclave_id>
```
